claim: To allow Route 53 health checks in a security group, you can allow each IP address range or use an AWS-managed prefix list. When you add the prefix list to your inbound security group, it automatically adds all necessary ranges.
question: Is there an AWS-managed prefix list for Route 53 health checkers?

values.display: it automatically adds all necessary ranges

qualifiers.scope: security groups for Route 53 health checks

evidence.quote: To configure your security groups to allow Route 53 health checks, you can either allow inbound traffic from each IP address range, or you can use an AWS-managed prefix list.
When you add the AWS-managed prefix list to your inbound security group, it automatically adds all necessary ranges.
